**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Avoid making home load a write-backed workspace**

When an authenticated user opens `/`, this redirect lands on `/learn/workspace/topic-trig-equations`; I traced that route through `useTopicWorkspacePageCoordinator`, where the initial load calls `ensureWorkspace`, and `ensureWorkspace` sends a `POST { action: 'ensure' }` to `/api/learning/workspaces/:id`. That means simply visiting the app home now performs an ensure/write-backed learning call rather than a read-only fixture/front-door load, creating production side effects and contradicting the fixture-backed/no-remote-writes boundary for this change.

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Treat explicit fallback posture as governed**

For the current session/workspace runtime payloads, the backend returns explicit fallback posture such as `release_scope_status: non_released_fallback` and `fallback_mode: non_released_fallback` without a `content_status` field (see the existing session and workspace API contract tests), but this candidate list ignores those fields and falls through to `ungoverned`. On those read-only/fallback surfaces the newly added `ProductPostureNotice` therefore says governance is unavailable even though a governed conservative fallback was supplied, so the adapter should map the explicit fallback posture instead of treating it as missing.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Preserve session release scope for the posture notice**

On drill/session routes this projected `runtimePosture` is passed into `ProductPostureNotice`, whose details render `releaseScopeStatus`, but the session API already returns `runtime_posture.release_scope_status` and this projection still drops it while adding the other product-posture fields. Any `/learn/session/:id` with an explicit released or non-released scope therefore omits that governance detail from the new notice even though workspace pages preserve it; include `releaseScopeStatus` in this returned view model.
